pinned.title: Message-a-buddy from its homepage
pinned.detail: Feature request for the Muse team (drafted, NOT sent): send a message to a side chat assistant straight from a box on an external web page and have it act right away — e.g. describing a change to a project dashboard page from the page itself. Parked 2026-10-11 at Dave's request; needs his go-ahead to file.

pinned.title: Quick-reply taps should carry their question
pinned.detail: Feature request for the Muse team (drafted, NOT sent): wants quick-reply option taps to carry which question they answer, so tapping an option from earlier in a long chat does not get matched to the wrong open question. Parked 2026-10-11 at Dave's request ("Park it too"); needs his go-ahead to file.
